_comment: Single source of truth for Claude Code MCP servers registered by setup-linux.sh and setup-windows.ps1. Add new servers here; both setup scripts pick them up automatically. Args is a space-separated string of arguments passed after `--` to `claude mcp add`.
_history: 2026-05-25 SDD-007: removed `drawio` (rarely used for diagram gen, spawned subprocess even with --pure) and `socket` (mcp.socket.dev remote endpoint hung 30s+ on tool discovery). User decision: keep only hive + context7 + sequential-thinking across all environments (Claude Code, opencode, agy).
